Chapter 759: Chapter 36: The Reappearance of Heaven’s Gate (Seeking Subscriptions)

Two-dimensional World.

Heavy snow whirled through the air, covering everything in a blanket of white.

Within Sea Moon City, Lin Yuan walked the streets, occasionally stopping to sit at a nearby table and chairs to sample the delicacies of Sea Moon City.

“Sea Moon City, established by the Sea Moon Tribe, is far from the twelve Ancient Countries. There are few conflicts here; the people of the Sea Moon Tribe dislike fighting amongst themselves and are very friendly to outsiders…”

While tasting the food, Lin Yuan pondered to himself.

Having spent ten thousand years, Lin Yuan had basically explored this Two-dimensional World once over; this was his second visit to Sea Moon City, the last time being eight thousand years ago.

...

He would only come to a place a second time if he especially liked a particular city.

And the cuisine of Sea Moon City was distinctive. Lin Yuan had revisited to experience the flavors here once more.

“Eight thousand years have passed, generations of the original citizens of Sea Moon City have come and gone, but the taste of the food hasn’t changed much…” Lin Yuan sipped his drink, which was blended from dozens of unique fruit juices, offering a truly unique flavor.

“The snow is getting heavier…”

Lin Yuan set down his drink, gazing at the snowflakes continually drifting down from the sky.

The snowflakes of the Two-dimensional World, each piece was like a work of art, resembling glittering jewels.

Lin Yuan reached out to catch the falling snowflakes, closely observing their intricate structures, maze-like, incredibly complex, yet the resulting snowflake was utterly perfect, just like a simplified version of this Two-dimensional World.

The more Lin Yuan observed, the more he was engrossed, completely immersing his mind in it.

[Your perception is defying heaven, studying the nature of the snowflake, deepening continuously…]

…

Lin Yuan was engrossed in the perfect structure of the snowflakes, completely unaware of the snow falling ever more heavily, as others quickly sought shelter inside stores, leaving him alone outside.

“Mom, is that man a foreigner?” A little girl inside the shop curiously watched Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan’s dress was quite distinctive from that of other citizens of Sea Moon City, making him recognizable immediately.

“How silly that foreigner is, the snow is falling so heavily, and he doesn’t come inside to take shelter.” The little girl blinked and couldn’t help but speak.

“You shouldn’t judge others like that,” the little girl’s mother scolded immediately, though her voice was somewhat gentle.

This was also a characteristic of the women of the Sea Moon Tribe, appearing weak but the citizens of Sea Moon City, men and women alike, were all fiercely spirited.

“Alright, alright…” The little girl bowed her head in admission, sounding aggrieved.

“But if he continues to stay out in the snow like that, he’ll surely catch a cold.” The mother furrowed her brow slightly, glancing at Lin Yuan sitting in the snow with some hesitation.

Just then.

[Your perception is defying heaven, observing the essence of the snowflake, breaking through to Witch Ancestor 136th Realm…]

…

Lin Yuan’s eyes sparkled, feeling the changes in his body’s Inner Qi, and he instinctively burst into laughter.

“Hahahaha…”

Although Lin Yuan tried to contain his energy, the horrifying sound waves nevertheless caused the air to surge, and everyone in Sea Moon City, including the city’s lord, who was a Witch Emperor, bore expressions of terror.

“What is this?”

Everyone inside the store felt the same, clutching their heads in agony.

Fortunately, Lin Yuan quickly halted his laughter, preventing any harm to the citizens.

“It’s time to leave.”

Lin Yuan glanced around and vanished.

…

Back in the store, the little girl and her mother finally recovered.

“Mom, that foreigner’s laughter was really scary…” The little girl trembled, hiding in her mother’s embrace.

“That foreigner must be an extraordinarily powerful being…” The mother’s voice also trembled, then sternly eyed the little girl, “Haven’t I taught you so many times not to judge others lightly? Fortunately, that powerful person didn’t take it to heart…”

The mother was somewhat frightened.

The mere laughter causing such a reaction, even the strongest city lord couldn’t achieve that, could they?

If Lin Yuan had minded her daughter’s remarks from earlier, their mother and daughter pair would have faced severe consequences.

“I understand, Mom…” Tears swirled in the little girl’s eyes, clearly understanding her mistake.

…

Outside Sea Moon City.

A figure stood in the air.

The heavy snowfall melted rapidly within a hundred meters of this figure, evaporated by the immense vitality.

“Ten thousand years, Witch Ancestor 136th Realm…”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

It took him over three hundred years to reach Witch Ancestor Fifty Realm from an ordinary person of the Two-dimensional World.

But advancing from Witch Ancestor Fifty Realm to Witch Ancestor 136th Realm took ten thousand years.

Lin Yuan was quite satisfied with this, knowing each leap in realm from Witch Ancestor Fifty Realm was not merely normal advancement but a struggle against the heaven and earth itself, seeking to break free from the constraints and suppression.

Originally, Lin Yuan’s plan was to reach Witch Ancestor Hundredth Realm in ten thousand years, but now reaching the 136th Realm far exceeded his expectations.

…

“In these ten thousand years, the powerhouses of Myriad Tribes have become fewer and fewer.”

Lin Yuan stood in the air, watching the snowflakes fall, pondering silently.

By his estimate, the total number of Myriad Tribes’ powerhouses in the Two-dimensional World should not exceed a thousand.

It was not that other powerhouses from Myriad Tribes had been exterminated, but that most realized that even if they remained, they couldn’t possibly go outside; rather than dying of old age in this Two-dimensional World, they might as well give up early and willingly extinguish their avatars.

In this Two-dimensional World, unable to comprehend many laws, staying longer wouldn’t provide any real enhancement to their true bodies outside.

“It’s about time to head for Heavenly Mountain.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, with half a year left until the gates to heaven opened once again.

…

Luo River gathering place.

After ten thousand years of evolution, the former Luo River gathering area had long since become Luo River City, and the city master was a descendant of Zha Ran Gu.

As for Zha Ran Gu himself? He had died of old age long ago.

However, because of Lin Yuan’s connections, Zha Ran Gu had a very comfortable life and even lived longer than other powerhouses of the same level.

Before heading to Heavenly Mountain, Lin Yuan deliberately stayed in Luo River City.

“My old residence is still preserved, unaltered…” Lin Yuan glanced and saw the cave where he used to meditate.

“In this two-dimensional world, I no longer have any acquaintances.” Lin Yuan only stayed in the ancient city of Luo River for a short while before he left directly.

Immediately after, Lin Yuan also made a special trip to the capital of Xueyu Ancient Country.

Just like Luo River City, the Xueyu Emperor had been replaced many times, and the title of Prince of the Northern Town had been reclaimed by one of the Xueyu Emperors.

Ten thousand years, times change, people change; even the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses, most of them find it difficult to survive that long, let alone the normal lifespan of a Witch Ancestor, which is just two to three thousand years.

To live past ten thousand years, one must at least reach the twentieth realm of Witch Ancestor, which only a few top-tier Tenth Rank and Eleventh Rank Powerhouses can manage to achieve.

Lin Yuan silently observed all this, then finally left the capital of Xueyu Ancient Country.

This time departing, even if he still couldn’t open the heavenly gate, Lin Yuan would not come back again.

…

On the summit of Heavenly Mountain.

Many Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses had arrived early.

Compared to the ‘bustle’ when the heavenly gate first opened.

This time, the summit of Heavenly Mountain was much colder.

Scattered around were several hundred Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses.

“After ten thousand years, I’ve far exceeded the exploration of the ‘supreme weapon’ within me compared to ten thousand years ago, and I estimate it could rival the Sixtieth Realm of a Witch Ancestor.”

At the summit of Heavenly Mountain, the Four Divine Kings stood quietly, their gazes emitting a hint of fighting spirit.

In a two-dimensional world, after Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses cultivate to the Tenth Realm of a Witch Ancestor, they will be suppressed by the heavens of this world, finding it hard to progress any further.

But this restriction, which applies to the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses, ‘relaxes’ greatly when it comes to the suppression of supreme weapons; the supreme weapon within the Four Divine Kings indeed shares some essence of a Supreme Being.

Excavating the power of that supreme weapon is much easier than elevating one’s own realm and power.

Without this supreme weapon, even over the past one hundred or two hundred thousand years, the Four Divine Kings could never have cultivated to the Sixtieth Realm of a Witch Ancestor.

“Now I, should be able to compete with the human ‘Xueyu’…” the Four Divine Kings enthusiastically declared, “Human Xueyu, your biggest mistake was not killing me back then.”

The Four Divine Kings steadied their spirits, their eyes blazing with fiery combat intent.

Suddenly.

At that moment.

In the central position of the summit.

Someone appeared, unnoticed.

“Human Xueyu.”

“Human Xueyu has arrived.”

The surrounding Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses perked up, all turning their attention.

In fact, most of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses had come to catch another glimpse of Lin Yuan, to see if Lin Yuan could push the heavenly gate this time.

“Human Xueyu!”

The Four Divine Kings were spirited, while also looking towards Lin Yuan.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan seemed to sense something, his gaze flickering towards the Four Divine Kings.

Boom!!!

Just a single glance caused the Four Divine Kings’ minds to thunder, their legs shaking uncontrollably. If not for fiercely relying on the power of the supreme weapon within, they might have collapsed on the spot.

“How is this possible?”

“How can he be so strong?”

The Four Divine Kings couldn’t help but roar inwardly, one gaze from Lin Yuan causing them to utterly falter, indicating that the gap between them and Lin Yuan had grown far wider than it had been ten thousand years before.

At least ten thousand years ago, facing a glance from Lin Yuan wasn’t nearly as unnerving.

“How could human civilization give birth to such a freak…” The Four Divine Kings finally managed to stabilize after stepping back several times.

…

Lin Yuan glanced back at the Four Divine Kings, also sensing some fiery emotion from the latter towards him.

In fact, Lin Yuan didn’t care much about the Four Divine Kings.

Ten thousand years ago, the Four Divine Kings were far from his match, and the gap between them had only grown over ten thousand years.

For Lin Yuan now, the only opponent in this two-dimensional world was that heavenly gate.

Time slowly passed.

Finally.

Above the summit of Heavenly Mountain, intense spatial fluctuations emerged once again.

A heavenly gate was slowly outlined, materializing in front of the many Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses.

…

Deep within the two-dimensional world.

In a vast space, in front of a giant scroll, a half-meter-tall old man yawned and slowly opened his eyes.

For him, ten thousand years in the two-dimensional world was nothing more than a short nap, incredibly brief.

“Let’s see how far ten thousand years can go…”

The half-meter-tall old man stretched, looking towards the giant scroll in front of him.

The scroll was cloaked in mist, encompassing a vast, real world.

“What?!!”

The moment the half-meter-tall old man looked, he was somewhat bewildered, as if he had seen a ghost.
